title: Fixed Russian LibriSpeech public-domain test subset

source.license: CC-BY-4.0 dataset card; upstream OpenSLR SLR96 states public domain in the USA
source.origin: Russian LibriSpeech derived from public-domain LibriVox audiobooks
source.attribution: OpenSLR SLR96 Russian LibriSpeech and Hugging Face conversion by istupakov

selection: Twenty-four row indexes were chosen by evenly spacing endpoints 0 through 1351 before any candidate output was viewed. This prevents result-driven sample selection and covers seven source-reader path prefixes.

acquisition.retention: Audio is downloaded only under the authorized Slice 2 cache. Git retains public metadata, references, revision, and later redacted aggregate scores only.

scoring.normalization: Unicode lowercase, Russian ё mapped to е, all characters except Cyrillic а-я and digits mapped to spaces, whitespace collapsed, then word tokenization.
scoring.aggregation: Micro-average Levenshtein word errors divided by total reference words over all 24 fixed samples; no cherry-picking or per-speaker exclusion.
